description: This Java source file defines the class ApiDemos, which extends ListActivity. It provides an interactive list of sample code activities in an Android application, creating a navigable menu based on the available activities registered in the package. The class includes methods for data population, intent creation for different activities, sorting, and handling list item clicks. It essentially functions as a dynamic menu interface that lists and launches various demo activities.

classes.name: ApiDemos
classes.description: Main class extending ListActivity, responsible for displaying a list of activity samples and handling navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves intent data, and sets up the list adapter.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Generates a list of data items representing available sample activities, based on a prefix for hierarchical navigation.

methods.name: activityIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent targeting a specific activity based on package name and component name.

methods.name: browseIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to navigate to another level in the demo hierarchy based on a path.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a data item to the list with a display name and associated intent.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on list items, starting the selected activity.
